python3 << 'PY'
import json
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

VALID_TYPES = ["Task","Method","Material","Metric","OtherScientificTerm","Generic"]
TYPE_MAP = {
    "otherscientificterm":"OtherScientificTerm",
    "other-scientificterm":"OtherScientificTerm",
    "other_scientific_term":"OtherScientificTerm",
    "scientificterm":"OtherScientificTerm",
    "other":"OtherScientificTerm",
}
def normalize_type(t):
    if not t: return None
    tn = t.strip().lower().replace(" ","").replace("_","").replace("-","")
    for vt in VALID_TYPES:
        if tn == vt.lower().replace(" ","").replace("_","").replace("-",""):
            return vt
    return TYPE_MAP.get(tn)

def analyze(path, label):
    cf_pairs = Counter()      # frozenset of types -> count of (doc, mention) violations
    cf_pair_2way = Counter()  # pairwise breakdown (for >2-type conflicts, count each pair)
    types_per_mention_size = Counter()
    total_mentions_with_violation = 0
    total_mentions_checked = 0
    docs = 0
    for line in open(path):
        rec = json.loads(line)
        docs += 1
        po = rec.get("parsed_output") or {}
        ents = po.get("entities", []) or []
        rels = po.get("relations", []) or []
        mention_types = defaultdict(set)
        for e in ents:
            text = (e.get("text") or "").lower().strip()
            nt = normalize_type(e.get("type",""))
            if nt and text:
                mention_types[text].add(nt)
        for r in rels:
            head = (r.get("head") or "").lower().strip()
            tail = (r.get("tail") or "").lower().strip()
            hn = normalize_type(r.get("head_type",""))
            tn = normalize_type(r.get("tail_type",""))
            if head and hn:
                mention_types[head].add(hn)
            if tail and tn:
                mention_types[tail].add(tn)
        for m, types in mention_types.items():
            total_mentions_checked += 1
            if len(types) > 1:
                total_mentions_with_violation += 1
                key = tuple(sorted(types))
                cf_pairs[key] += 1
                types_per_mention_size[len(types)] += 1
                sorted_types = sorted(types)
                for i in range(len(sorted_types)):
                    for j in range(i+1, len(sorted_types)):
                        cf_pair_2way[(sorted_types[i], sorted_types[j])] += 1
    print(f"\n=== {label} ===")
    print(f"docs={docs}, unique mentions checked={total_mentions_checked}, CF violations(mentions w/ >1 type)={total_mentions_with_violation}")
    print(f"Sizes of conflicting type sets: {dict(types_per_mention_size)}")
    print(f"\nFull conflict type-set distribution ({len(cf_pairs)} unique sets):")
    for k,v in cf_pairs.most_common():
        print(f"  {' & '.join(k)}: {v}")
    print(f"\nPairwise breakdown (each pair counted even in >2-type conflicts):")
    for k,v in cf_pair_2way.most_common(15):
        print(f"  {k[0]} <-> {k[1]}: {v}")
